Synthetic binary fixtures, not Android applications.

old/app.apk = bytes(range(256)) repeated 1024 times.
new/app.apk = old[:8192] + b'Appfredo update test' + old[8211:] + b'new release'.
update.pwr was generated by butler v15.31.0 (54a2dd86ed68):
  butler diff --verify old/ new/ update.pwr

The desktop and Android tests apply this same Brotli-compressed Wharf patch.
